nom: medicube PDRN Toner Salmon DNA Milky Toner

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily and sensitive skin reports a severe allergic reaction requiring a hospital visit after two days of use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who calls her skin "as dry as a desert," consistently report the toner leaves their skin deeply hydrated, plumped and glowing.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one also managing sensitivity, report strong hydration with no irritation.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation and good hydration, but two describe serious negative reactions: one had breakouts an esthetician linked to the product, and another had an allergic reaction requiring a hospital visit.
segments.normal: One reviewer says the toner leaves her skin looking normal rather than the shiny glow shown in marketing photos, describing it as decent but not living up to her expectations.

concerns.dehydration: Hydration is by far the most consistently reported benefit, with reviewers describing plump, dewy, glass-like skin even in dry climates or on dehydrated skin, though a couple of reviewers say it felt sticky, formed a film that didn't absorb, or made little noticeable difference.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea and redness-prone skin reports her skin looked worse, with more breakouts across her forehead, cheeks and nose, after weeks of use, and stopped after her esthetician linked it to the product; her skin cleared up once she discontinued it.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the niacinamide, ceramides and panthenol in the formula with supporting the skin barrier.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several reviewers, including some who normally break out from new products, say this one did not cause breakouts, while others describe new milia, scabbing from picking, or breakouts they or their esthetician linked directly to the product.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the toner absorbs without feeling oily or leaving any shine.

aspects.libelle: Thick, milky texture that absorbs without stickiness
Large bottle seen as good value, lasts a long time
Attractive pink packaging with clearly printed expiration date
Best patted in by hand; a cotton pad wastes product or picks up fibers
Can dry sticky or gummy if it gets into the eye or lash area

extraits.titre: Caused breakouts but all skin is different
extraits.texte: I have been having issues with my skin (redness- no blemishes) and decided to purchase this toner along with other Medicube PDRN products. After a few weeks and what seemed to be worse skin issues, I went and had a consult with an esthetician. Let me also say that I know it is sometimes normal for the skin to purge when introducing a new product into your skincare regimen. So I thought that was what I was experiencing. At my consult, I brought all my skincare products with me and she said that they were sufficient for the time being. I had a treatment with her the next day and a second a month later. She took pictures at my first appointment and when she compared that photo to my skin on the second appointment, she agreed that my skin did look worse than my first appointment (a lot of breakouts on my forehead, cheeks, and nose) and recommended that I discontinued the use of this product because she had seen in esthetician groups online that many people were reporting breakouts following the use of this toner. I followed her instructions and sure enough, the breakouts I was having cleared up. That being said, everyone’s skin is different. I have very sensitive, normal to dry skin and rosacea. So if you have the same type of skin, I would just be aware that any negative changes to your skin after introducing this product could be caused by it. This could be a five star product for some but it wasn’t the case for me.

extraits.titre: The worst thing that ever happened to me 😬
extraits.texte: I purchased some products from Medicube and COSRX, specifically the Medicube Toner, Toner Pad, Serum and the COSRX Snail Mucin 92% Moisturizer. After only two days of use, my face became hot, itchy, and swollen. I had to visit the hospital, and the doctor confirmed it was an allergic reaction. I have oily and sensitive skin, so these products didn’t work well for me. I hope the brands will be more careful with their formulas and do more testing for people with sensitive skin like mine. I’m not writing this to attack the brand, but to warn others who may have sensitive skin to be cautious.

This product does make your skin glowy but Im not sure if its this or the collagen jelly cream but one of these is making me wake up the next day with milia on my face. I have PCOS and struggle with cystic acne. My skin cleared up with spironalactone and korean skincare products so I wanted to try this toner to see if it could improve even more. I struggle with picking at pimples and the ones I get dont pop so now I have scabs on my face for the first time in a while and Im devastated. The attached photo is my skin under makeup. Updated to add a star because the company reached out and offered me a full refund

My skin is as dry as a desert but this stuff feels amazing on my face. I love it so much and it has become part of my nightly skincare routine before bed. However, I also use this as a primer, before I apply my makeup just for an extra moisture boost. I apply it directly to my face, no cotton balls required; that will only soak up and waste the product. The photo I included here is after my skincare & makeup is all done. I really love the natural sheen of how it makes my skin look but you can definitely notice it more in person. I really have to fight the urge to touch my face all day. If you want moisture rich glass skin and you’re into the dewy look, this is for you.

extraits.titre: Gentle, Hydrating, and Soothing Toner for Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: The Pink Niacinamide Milky Toner by Medicube is from a solid Korean skincare brand. It comes out as a pink liquid, thicker than most toners, and absorbs nicely into my skin. It feels cooling and calming to my face, and I didn't notice any odor. I have sensitive and combination skin. My skincare goals include minimizing pores, redness, and hyperpigmentation. After just one use, my face felt very hydrated without any noticable irritation. At the time of this review, the price ($20) is really good for the quality.

Not sure how glassy this makes skin, but the formula is definitely milky pink, absorbs nicely into my skin to leave it smooth. I look for products with niacinamide to help with my skin tone and clarity. I've only just started using PDRN products so looking forward to seeing if this helps with texture and elasticity. Ingredients list is pretty long and it does contain ethylhexyl palmitate near the top of the list, which can be comedogenic for some (I have pretty dry skin so it hasn't made me break out).
I break out any time I add something new to my skin. But with this I did NOT. Smoother, glowy and hydrated skin. So good!
